plugins.name: LDAP NULL BASE Search Access
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server may disclose sensitive information.
plugins.description:
The remote LDAP server supports search requests with a NULL, or empty,
base object. This allows information to be retrieved without any prior
knowledge of the directory structure. Coupled with a NULL BIND, an
anonymous user may be able to query your LDAP server using a tool such
as 'LdapMiner'. 

Note that there are valid reasons to allow queries with a NULL base.
For example, it is required in version 3 of the LDAP protocol to
provide access to the root DSA-Specific Entry (DSE), with information
about the supported naming context, authentication types, and the
like. It also means that legitimate users can find information in the
directory without any prior knowledge of its structure. As such, this
finding may be a false-positive.
plugins.solution:
If the remote LDAP server supports a version of the LDAP protocol
before v3, consider whether to disable NULL BASE queries on your LDAP
server.

plugins.name: LDAP Server NULL Bind Connection Information Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server allows anonymous access.
plugins.description:
The LDAP server on the remote host is currently configured such that a
user can connect to it without authentication - via a 'NULL BIND' -
and query it for information.  Although the queries that are allowed
are likely to be fairly restricted, this may result in disclosure of
information that an attacker could find useful.

This plugin does not identify servers that use LDAP v3 since
anonymous access -- a 'NULL BIND' -- is required by that version
of the protocol.
plugins.solution: Configure the service to disallow NULL BINDs.

plugins.name: Novell NetWare LDAP Server Anonymous Bind
plugins.synopsis: Information can be read on the remote LDAP server.
plugins.description:
The server's directory base is set to NULL. This allows information to be 
enumerated without any prior knowledge of the directory structure.
plugins.solution: Disable or restrict anonymous binds in LDAP if not required.

plugins.name: MS04-011: Microsoft Windows SSL Library Malformed Message Remote DoS (835732) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host seems to be running a version of Microsoft SSL library
which is vulnerable to several flaws, ranging from a denial of service
to remote code executing.

Any Microsoft service that utilizes SSL is vulnerable.  This
includes IIS 4.0, IIS 5.0, IIS 5.1, Exchange Server 5.5, Exchange Server
2000, Exchange Server 2003, and Analysis Services 2000 (included with
SQL Server 2000).
plugins.solution: Install the Windows cumulative update from Microsoft.

plugins.name: Hydra: LDAP
plugins.synopsis: It may be possible to determine LDAP accounts through brute force.
plugins.description:
This plugin runs Hydra to find LDAP accounts and passwords by brute
force. 

To use this plugin, enter the 'Logins file' and the 'Passwords file'
under the 'Hydra (NASL wrappers options)' advanced settings block.
plugins.solution: Change the passwords for the affected accounts.

plugins.name: CommuniGate Pro Server < 5.0.7 LDAP BER Decoding Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote application is prone to denial of service attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host appears to be running CommuniGate Pro, a commercial
email and groupware application. 

The version of CommuniGate Pro installed on the remote host includes
an LDAP server that reportedly fails to handle requests with negative
BER lengths.  A user can leverage this issue to crash not just the
LDAP server but also the entire application on the remote host. 
Remote code execution may even be possible.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to CommuniGate Pro version 5.0.7 or later.

plugins.name: LDAP Server Detection
plugins.synopsis: An LDAP server was detected on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol
(LDAP) server. LDAP is a protocol for providing access to directory
services over TCP/IP.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Sun ONE Directory Server LDAP Malformed Packet DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server is prone to denial of service attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host appears to be running Sun ONE Directory Server, an
LDAP directory from Sun. 

The version of Sun ONE Directory Server fails to handle certain
malformed search requests.  A user can leverage this issue to crash
not just the LDAP server but also the entire application on the remote
host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Sun ONE Directory Server 5.2patch5.

plugins.name: CommuniGate Pro Server < 5.0.8 LDAP Module Field Handling Remote DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote application is prone to denial of service attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host appears to be running CommuniGate Pro, a commercial
email and groupware application. 

The version of CommuniGate Pro installed on the remote host includes
an LDAP server that fails to handle requests with Distinguished 
Names (DNs) that contain too many elements.  A user can leverage this 
issue to crash not just the LDAP server, but also the entire 
application on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to CommuniGate Pro version 5.0.8 or later.

plugins.name: Lotus Domino LDAP Server Crafted Packet Remote DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote LDAP server is affected by a denial of service
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The LDAP server on the remote host appears to have crashed after being
sent a malformed request.  The specific request used is known to crash
the LDAP server in Lotus Domino 7.0.  By leveraging this flaw, an
attacker may be able to deny service to legitimate users.
plugins.solution: Unknown at this time.

plugins.name: IBM Tivoli Directory Server LDAP Packet Handling DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server is prone to denial of service attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host appears to be running IBM Tivoli Directory Server, an
LDAP directory from IBM. 

The version of IBM Tivoli Directory Server fails to handle certain
malformed search requests.  A user can leverage this issue to crash
the LDAP server.
plugins.solution:
Apply the appropriate fix pack listed in the vendor support documents
referenced above.

plugins.name: OpenLDAP SASL authcid Name BIND Request DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server is prone to a denial of service attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host appears to be running OpenLDAP, an open source LDAP
directory implementation. 

The version of OpenLDAP installed on the remote host fails to handle
malformed SASL bind requests.  An unauthenticated attacker can
leverage this issue to crash the LDAP server on the affected host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to OpenLDAP 2.3.29 or later.

plugins.name: Kerio MailServer < 6.3.1 Long LDAP Query DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server is prone to a denial of service attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running Kerio MailServer, a commercial mail server
available for Windows, Linux, and Mac OS X platforms. 

According to its banner, the LDAP service associated with the
installed version of Kerio MailServer terminates abnormally when it
receives certain malformed LDAP search requests.  An unauthenticated,
remote attacker can exploit this issue to deny access to legitimate
users.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Kerio MailServer 6.3.1 or later.

plugins.name: MS07-039: Vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Could Allow Remote Code Execution (926122) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute code on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Active Directory contains a flaw in the LDAP
request handler code that may allow an attacker to execute code
on the remote host.

On Windows 2000, an anonymous attacker can exploit this flaw by
sending a specially crafted LDAP packet.

Additionally, Active Directory is affected by a remote denial of
service vulnerability.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: LDAP Crafted Search Request Server Information Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to discover information about the remote LDAP server.
plugins.description:
By sending a search request with a filter set to 'objectClass=*', it
is possible to extract information about the remote LDAP server.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Sun Java System Directory Server Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server has multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running the Sun Java System Directory Server, an
LDAP server from Sun Microsystems. 

The remote version of this service is affected by multiple
vulnerabilities.  Versions 6.0 and prior to 5.2 Patch 5 are affected
by :

  - list attributes information disclosure
  - Unauthorized Access (restricted to super users). 

Versions prior to 5.2 Patch 5 are affected by :

  - Denial of service due to the BER decoding handler
  - Memory corruption in the failed request handler.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to Sun Java System Directory Server 5.2 Patch 5 or 6.1 or
later.

plugins.name: SIDVault < 2.0f LDAP Server Malformed Search Request Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server is vulnerable to a buffer overflow attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running SIDVault, an LDAP v3 server for Windows and
Linux. 

According to its banner, the version of SIDVault on the remote host
fails to handle certain malformed search requests.  A user reportedly
can leverage this issue to crash the affected service or execute
arbitrary code on the affected system with root or SYSTEM-level
privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to SIDVault version 2.0f or later.

plugins.name: IBM Domino Detection (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: IBM Domino is running on the remote host.
plugins.description:
IBM Domino (formerly IBM Lotus Domino), an enterprise application for
collaborative messaging, scheduling, directory services, and web
services, is running on the remote host.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Sun Java System Directory Server bind-dn Remote Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis:
The remote LDAP proxy server is prone to an unauthorized access
attack.
plugins.description:
The version of Sun Java System Directory Proxy Server running on the
remote host is affected by an unauthorized access vulnerability. 
Specifically, the server fails to properly classify connections in
relation to 'bind_dn' parameter.  Successful exploitation of this
issue might allow an unprivileged user to gain remote administrative
access to the system.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Sun Java System Directory Server 6.3 or later.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8.2 FTF2 / 8.7.3 SP10b Multiple Remote Overflows
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service is affected by multiple buffer overflows.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell.

The installed version of eDirectory is affected by an integer overflow
issue in ds.dlm / dhost.exe (bound by default to TCP port 524) as well
as a heap-based buffer overflow that can be triggered by passing NULL
search parameters to the LDAP service.  An unauthenticated attacker
may be able to leverage either issue to execute code on the remote
host with SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8.2 FTF2 / 8.7.3 SP10b or later.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8 SP3 Multiple Vulnerabilities (OF, XSS, MC)
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell.  The installed version of Novell eDirectory is affected
by multiple issues :

  - NDS module is affected by a heap overflow vulnerability 
    (Bugs 396819 and 396817).

  - Windows installs of eDirectory NDS module are affected 
    by a remote memory corruption vulnerability (Bug 373852).

  - LDAP module is affected by a buffer overflow 
    vulnerability (Bug 373853).

  - Windows installs of eDirectory LDAP module are affected
    by a memory corruption DoS (Bug 359982).

  - HTTPSTK is affected by two heap overflow vulnerabilities 
    affecting 'Language' and 'Content Length' headers in 
    HTTPSTK (Bugs 379882 and 379880).

  - HTTPSTK is also affected by a cross-site scripting 
    vulnerability (Bug 387429).
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8 SP3 or later.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.7.3 SP10 FTF1 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell.  The installed version of Novell eDirectory is affected
by multiple heap overflows and denial of service vulnerabilities :

  - DS module is affected by two heap overflow vulnerabilities
    (Bugs 407275, 407256).

  - EMBOX module is affected by two denial of service vulnerabilities
    (Bugs 407243, 407245).
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.7.3 SP10 FTF1 or later.

plugins.name: Sun Java System Directory Server 6.x < 6.3.1 LDAP JDBC Backend DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote LDAP server is affected by a denial of service vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running the Sun Java System Directory Server, an
LDAP server from Sun Microsystems.  

The installed version is older than 6.3.1, and the proxy server
included with such versions is reportedly affected by a denial of
service vulnerability.  By sending a specially crafted request to the
JDBC backend through the proxy server, an unauthenticated, remote
attacker may be able to trigger a denial of service condition.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Sun Java System Directory Server version 6.3.1.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8 SP3 FTF3 iMonitor HTTP Accept-Language Header Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote web server is affected by a buffer overflow
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell. The iMonitor component included with the installed version
is affected by a buffer overflow vulnerability. By sending a specially
crafted HTTP request to the iMonitor component with a malformed
'Accept-Language' header, it may be possible for a remote attacker
to execute arbitrary code on the remote system.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8 SP3 with FTF3 or later.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8 SP5 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell.  The installed version of this software is affected by
multiple issues :

  - Malformed bind LDAP packet causes eDir crash.
    (Bug 492692)

  - The use of multiple wildcards in RDNs can trigger a
    remote denial of service vulnerability. (Bug 458504)

  - An HTTP request containing a specially crafted
    'Accept-Language' header can trigger a stack-based
    buffer overflow. This issue affects the iMonitor
    service. (Bugs 484007 and 446342)
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8 SP5 or later.

plugins.name: LDAP Service STARTTLS Command Support
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service supports encrypting traffic.
plugins.description:
The remote LDAP service supports the use of the 'STARTTLS' command to
switch from a cleartext to an encrypted communications channel.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8.5 ftf1/8.7.3.10 ftf2 NULL Base DN DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote directory service is affected by a denial of service
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell. 

The installed version of eDirectory is affected by a denial of service
issue. By sending a search request with an undefined BaseDN, it may be
possible for an attacker to make the directory server unresponsive.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8.5 ftf1 / 8.7.3.10 ftf2 or later.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8.5.2 / 8.7.3.10 ftf2 'NDS Verb' Request Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote directory service is affected by a remote buffer overflow
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell. 

The installed version of eDirectory is affected by a remote buffer
overflow vulnerability.  By sending a specially crafted 'NDS Verb 0x1'
request, it may be possible for an attacker to execute arbitrary code
subject to the privileges of the affected service.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8.5.2 / 8.7.3.10 ftf2 or later.

plugins.name: Sun Java System Directory Proxy Server 6.x < 6.3.1.1 Multiple Vulnerabilities.
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running the Sun Java System Directory Proxy
Server, an LDAP application-layer protocol gateway.  It is typically
provided with Sun Java System Directory Server Enterprise Edition. 

The installed version of Sun Java System Directory Proxy Server is
older than 6.3.1.1 and thus affected by multiple flaws :

  - Under certain conditions, simultaneous long binds are
    incorrectly assigned the same back-end connection. An
    attacker may exploit this vulnerability to hijack
    an authenticated user's session and perform unauthorized
    operations. (CVE-2009-4440)
 
  - 'SO_KEEPALIVE' socket option is not enabled, making it
    possible for a remote attacker to trigger a denial of
    service condition by exhausting available connection
    slots. (CVE-2009-4441)
 
  - 'max-client-connections' configuration setting is not 
    correctly implemented, making it possible for a remote
    attacker to trigger a denial of service condition.
    (CVE-2009-4442)

  - An unspecified vulnerability in 'psearch' functionality
    may allow an attacker to trigger a denial of service
    condition. (CVE-2009-4443)
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to Sun Java System Directory Server Enterprise Edition version 6.3.1 
and then install patch 141958-01 or later.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8 SP5 Patch 3 eMBox SOAP Request DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote web server is affected by a denial of service
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell.

The eMBox service included with the installed version of eDirectory is
affected by a denial of service vulnerability.  

By sending a specially crafted HTTP SOAP request, it may be possible
for a remote attacker to crash the remote service.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8 SP5 Patch 3 or later.

plugins.name: LDAP Group Enumeration
plugins.synopsis: Nessus was able to get the list of groups on the remote LDAP server.
plugins.description:
By using the search base gathered by plugin ID 25701, Nessus was able
to enumerate the list of groups in the remote LDAP directory.
plugins.solution: Configure the LDAP server to require authentication.

plugins.name: LDAP User Enumeration
plugins.synopsis: Nessus was able to get the list of users on the remote LDAP server.
plugins.description:
By using the search base gathered by plugin ID 25701, Nessus was able
to enumerate the list of users in the remote LDAP directory.
plugins.solution: Configure the LDAP server to require authentication.

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8 SP5 Patch 4 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote directory service is affected by multiple
vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell.  The installed version of this software is affected by
one or more of the following vulnerabilities :

  - A denial of service vulnerability in NDSD when handling
    a malformed verb. (Bug 571244)

  - A stack-based buffer overflow in the dhost module
    for Windows. (Bug 588883)

  - A predictable session cookie in DHOST. (Bug 586854)
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8 SP5 Patch 4 or later.

plugins.name: CA eTrust Directory SNMP Packet Parsing Denial of Service
plugins.synopsis:
The remote directory server is affected by a denial of service
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
CA eTrust Directory, a directory service application, is installed on
the remote host.  Versions of CA eTrust Directory 8.1 and R12 earlier
than service pack 7 CR1 are potentially affected by a denial of
service vulnerability due to the way the application parses SNMP
packets.  A remote, unauthenticated attacker could exploit this flaw
to crash the affected service.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to CA eTrust Directory R12 SP7 CR1 (build 6279) or later.

plugins.name: LDAP 'Domain Admins' Group Membership Enumeration
plugins.synopsis:
Nessus was able to list the members of the 'Domain Admins' group on
the remote LDAP server.
plugins.description:
By using the search base gathered by plugin ID 25701 and the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to enumerate the list of members of the
'Domain Admins' group in the remote LDAP directory. Several Domain Admins groups may be returned if the LDAP port corresponds to a Global Catalog server (i.e. 3268/3269)
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: OS Identification : LDAP
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to identify the remote operating system based on an
LDAP query.
plugins.description:
The remote operating system can be identified through its response
to a search request with a filter set to 'objectClass=*'.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory < 8.8 SP6 Patch 5 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service application
from Novell.  According to its self-reported version number, this
software is affected by multiple stack-based buffer overflow and memory
corruption vulnerabilities.  A remote, unauthenticated attacker could
exploit the most severe of these vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary
code.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8 SP6 Patch 5 or later.

plugins.name: IBM Tivoli Directory Server TLS NULL Cipher (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote IBM Tivoli Directory Server contains an information
disclosure vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The IBM Tivoli Directory Server hosted on the remote host supports TLS
NULL-MD5 or NULL_SHA ciphers.  This allows remote, unauthenticated
attackers to trigger unencrypted communication via the TLS handshake
protocol.

Note that this version of Directory Server likely has other
vulnerabilities (i.e., CVE-2012-0743), but Nessus has not checked
for those issues.
plugins.solution:
Install the appropriate fix based on the vendor's advisory :

  - 6.1.0.47-ISS-ITDS-IF0047
  - 6.2.0.22-ISS-ITDS-IF0022
  - 6.3.0.11-ISS-ITDS-IF0011

plugins.name: Novell eDirectory 8.8.x Multiple Security Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote directory service is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eDirectory, a directory service software
from Novell.  The installed version of Novell eDirectory is affected by
multiple issues :

  - An unspecified cross-site scripting flaw exists.
    (CVE-2012-0428)

  - It is possible to trigger a remote denial of service 
    vulnerability by sending a malformed HTTP request. 
    (CVE-2012-0429)
 
  - An unspecified flaw may allow a remote attacker to gain 
    access to administrator cookie information. 
    (CVE-2012-0430)

  - There is an unspecified stack-based buffer overflow in 
    the Novell NCP implementation in eDirectory that has 
    unspecified impact. (CVE-2012-0432)
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eDirectory 8.8 SP6 Patch 7 / 8.8 SP7 Patch 2 or later.

plugins.name: Symantec Encryption Management Server < 3.3.2 Information Disclosure
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host is affected by an information disclosure
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of Symantec Encryption Management Server listening on the
remote host is earlier than version 3.3.2.  It is, therefore, affected
by an information disclosure vulnerability due to a flaw in the Web
Email Protection component.  A remote, authenticated attacker could
potentially exploit this vulnerability to view the contents of another
user's outbound emails.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 3.3.2 or later.

plugins.name: Symantec Encryption Management Server < 3.3.2 MP7 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The version of Symantec Encryption Management Server listening on the
remote host is prior to version 3.3.2 MP7. It is, therefore, affected
by multiple vulnerabilities :

  - A flaw exists in the handling of specially formatted PGP
    keys to the integrated key management server. This
    allows a remote attacker to inject email headers in
    order to manipulate fields within the key or
    confirmation email. (CVE-2014-7287)

  - A flaw exists in '/usr/bin/pgpbackup' when handling
    filename values. This allows an authenticated, local
    attacker to execute arbitrary commands with the use of a
    pipe character. (CVE-2014-7288)
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 3.3.2 MP7 or later.

plugins.name: Symantec Encryption Management Server 3.3.2 < 3.3.2 MP12 Multiple Vulnerabilities (SYM16-002)
plugins.synopsis:
A security policy management application running on the remote host is
affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The version of Symantec Encryption Management Server running on the
remote host is 3.3.2 prior to version 3.3.2 MP12. It is, therefore, 
affected by multiple vulnerabilities :

  - An unspecified flaw in the LDAP service allows a remote
    attacker, via a crafted LDAP request, to gather
    sensitive information about valid administrator accounts
    on the server. (CVE-2015-8148)

  - A denial of service exists in the LDAP service due to a
    failure to properly validate user-supplied input. An
    unauthenticated, remote attacker can exploit this, via
    crafted request packets, to cause corrupted memory block
    headers, leading to a SIGSEGV fault and resulting in a
    service halt. (CVE-2015-8149)

  - An unspecified flaw exists that is related to scheduling
    commands to run via existing batch files, which normally
    run with root privileges. A local attacker can exploit
    this to gain elevated privileges on the server.
    (CVE-2015-8150)

  - A command injection vulnerability exists in the web user
    interface due to a failure to properly sanitize certain
    user-supplied input fields. An authenticated, remote
    attacker can exploit this to run arbitrary commands with
    elevated privileges on the underlying operating system.
    (CVE-2015-8151)
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to Symantec Encryption Management Server version 3.3.2 MP12 or
later.

plugins.name: Symantec Encryption Management Server Remote Administrator Enumeration
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host is affected by an information disclosure
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The Symantec Encryption Management Server running on the remote host
is affected by an information disclosure vulnerability when handling
LDAP requests. An unauthenticated, remote attacker can exploit this,
via a crafted request, to obtain sensitive information about
administrator accounts.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Symantec Encryption Management Server version 3.3.2 MP12

plugins.name: Symantec Encryption Management Server < 3.4.2 MP1 Denial of Service Vulnerability (SYMSA1458)
plugins.synopsis:
A security policy management application running on the remote host is
affected by a denial of service vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of Symantec Encryption Management Server running on the
remote host is prior to version 3.4.2 MP1. It is, therefore,
affected by an unspecified denial of service vulnerability.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to Symantec Encryption Management Server version 3.4.2 MP1 or
later.
